messages:
maria: heads-up — I hacked together a small prototype for a loader-side compatibility gate to handle mixed safetensors/plain-pt shards. goal: single loader path that picks zero-copy vs stream-warmup depending on file headers.
josh: nice. can you sketch the gate API? is this something the runtime sees or purely loader-level?
maria: loader-level only. idea: top-level header with a 4-byte magic + a compatibility version field (compat_v). loader peeks first 64 bytes, decides one of: ZERO_COPY_OK, STREAM_ONLY, FALLBACK_TO_INDEX. no manifest mutation.
derek: love the minimal surface. what about sharded bundles where some shards are ZERO_COPY_OK and others are STREAM_ONLY? we need a consistent warmup strategy for a model load.
katie: proposal: gate returns a per-shard hint and an aggregate model mode: prefer_zero_copy if >=80% shards allow; otherwise stream-first. that keeps behavior predictable for most bundles.
maria: exactly. also returning per-shard checksum (small hash in header) so we can validate while streaming and avoid re-download on partial failure.
josh: how do we version the header without breaking older safetensors? do we require new producers to write header, or shim on ingest?
\dmaria: (typo: derek) we can do dual compatibility: if header absent, treat as STREAM_ONLY. new writers add compat_v and checksum. ingestion pipeline can add a sidecar header for legacy uploads (cheap).
derek: sidecar sounds OK for hosted, but for private/on-prem we can’t mutate customer files. need runtime fallback detection: sniff pattern for safetensors signature (we already do), if no header -> STREAM_ONLY.
katie: question about mmap: ZERO_COPY_OK implies we memory-map and pin pages; but quantized files sometimes need byte-swapping/transform so zero-copy isn't possible even if file layout says OK. we need an additional flag: TRANSFORM_REQUIRED.
maria: agree. header fields: compat_v, flags (ZERO_COPY, TRANSFORM_REQUIRED), shard_checksum, small sequence id. simple.
josh: performance tradeoffs — streaming warmup gives better tail latency under cold start thanks to progressive hydration. zero-copy is great for steady-state. can we hybridize? start streaming first chunk while mmap-ing rest in background?
maria: yup — loader can start a lightweight stream reader for the first few layers (prefix caching) and concurrently mmap. I call that "stream-then-mmap" warmup. avoids big stalls while enabling eventual zero-copy.
\kderek: scheduling complexity: if stream-then-mmap starts too many simultaneous pulls it hurts IO. recommend a single-threaded prefix fetch per model + background mmaps with IO rate limit.
katie: +1. Also add an explicit API hook in the loader: on_prefetch_hint(model_id, priority, method) so orchestrator can bump priority for canary requests.
josh: what about evictions & partial shards — if mmap fails due to OOM on a node, we should fallback to streaming without panic. plumb an eviction-safe fence.
\dmaria: we should define a clear fallback sequence: 1) attempt mode chosen by aggregate hint, 2) on OOM/IO err -> transition to STREAM_ONLY for that shard, 3) publish event to metrics + fallback counter, 4) continue. make it seamless to callers.
infrastructure note: infra-bot: deploy pipeline will add a compatibility-check step for new checkout that flags missing header fields for model-bundles in the model-registry (opt-in rollout).
josh: can we make the header tiny? 32 bytes per shard incl checksum and flags is fine. avoid big per-shard metadata.
maria: yep. header layout example: ````
0x53 0x46 0x54 0x00  // 'SFT\0' magic
uint8 compat_v
uint8 flags
uint16 reserved
uint64 shard_checksum
uint32 seq_id
````
josh: looks good. make sure endian agreed and checksum is something fast (xxhash64).
katie: also need a graceful rollout plan: start by producing headers in new model uploads, update hosted ingestion to add sidecar headers for legacy, roll loader change in two phases: read-only safe mode (treat missing header as stream) then enable canary branch for stream-then-mmap.
derek: testing plan: unit tests for per-shard fallback, e2e perf test with mixed-shard bundles, chaos test where mmap returns ENOMEM mid-hydration.
maria: I've got a draft PR with header parser + stream-then-mmap shim. will post link shortly. feedback welcome on naming & flags.
josh: add a small telemetry tag for "warmup_path=zero_copy|stream|hybrid" so we can quantify benefits.
katie: also add a tiny prometheus counter for header_mismatch & checksum_mismatch.
maria: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
infra-bot: rollout-notes: compat-gate feature flagged under eng-ml/loader/compat-gate, default off. monitor metrics for 72h on canary.
derek: cool, excited to see perf numbers.
